name: NamedSlideShows
description: A collection of all the NamedSlideShow objects in the presentation. Each NamedSlideShow object represents a custom slide show.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single NamedSlideShow object from the specified NamedSlideShows collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the single NamedSlideShow object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, safeArrayOfSlideIDs As Variant) As NamedSlideShow
methods.description: Creates a new named slide show and adds it to the collection of named slide shows in the specified presentation. Returns a NamedSlideShow object that represents the new named slide show.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the slide show.

parameters.name: safeArrayOfSlideIDs
parameters.description: Contains the unique slide IDs of the slides to be displayed in a slide show.
